import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

pull_path = Path('results/training/kaggle_composition_ablation.json')
pull = json.loads(pull_path.read_text())
assert pull['status'] == 'outputs_retrieved'
out = Path('results/kaggle/composition-ablation-v1')
shutil.copytree('runs/kaggle_composition_ablation_output', out, dirs_exist_ok=True)
pair = json.loads((out / 'pair_runtime.json').read_text())
record = {'provenance':receipt({'purpose':'retain every batch-composition development case'},pair['model_revision']),
          'source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'download_receipt':str(pull_path),'pair_runtime':pair,
          'files_sha256':{str(p):file_sha256(p) for p in out.rglob('*') if p.is_file()},'stages':{},
          'interpretation':'Development-state composition diagnostics, not a policy candidate or test score. Direct generation bypasses caching/deduplication and repair; comparison is within this configuration. Changes do not alone identify padding versus floating-point kernel effects.'}
for stage in ('sft','grpo'):
    path = out/stage/'inference_profile.json'
    if not path.exists():
        record['stages'][stage] = {'status':'profile_not_saved'}
        continue
    p = json.loads(path.read_text())
    prior = json.loads(Path(f'results/kaggle/compiler-ablation-v1/{stage}/inference_profile.json').read_text())
    assert p['prompts_sha256'] == prior['prompts_sha256'] and p['states'] == prior['states']
    s = {'status':p['status'],'cases':[]}
    if 'serial' in p:
        s['serial_changes_vs_prior'] = [i for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(p['serial']['answers'],prior['initial_serial_baseline_including_warmup']['quotes'])) if a['quote'] != b]
    for case in p['cases']:
        s['cases'].append({'name':case['name'],'wall_seconds':case['wall_seconds'],
                           'peak_allocated_bytes':case['peak_allocated_bytes'],
                           'changed_state_indices':[case['answers'][i]['state_index'] for i in case['mismatch_positions']],
                           'parse_errors':sum(a['parse_error'] is not None for a in case['answers'])})
    record['stages'][stage] = s
Path('results/training/kaggle_composition_ablation_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
p = Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json')
ledger = json.loads(p.read_text())
for session in ledger['sessions']:
    if session['kernel'] == pull['metadata']['id'] and session['version'] == 1:
        session.update(status='completed_outputs_retrieved' if pair['exit_codes'] == [0,0] else 'partial_outputs_retrieved',
                       script_wall_seconds=pair['wall_seconds'],hours=pair['wall_seconds']/3600,
                       hours_basis='Downloaded script runtime; exact allocation billing boundaries unavailable.',
                       observed_complete_at=pull['polls'][-1]['at'],result_file=str(out/'pair_runtime.json'))
p.write_text(json.dumps(ledger,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'runtime_seconds':pair['wall_seconds'],'exit_codes':pair['exit_codes'],'stages':record['stages']},indent=2))

pair_runtime.purpose: Development-state batch composition and prompt-length invariance; no held-out policy episodes.
